checks: Conversation has no dimming or tutorial bubble; unrelated content and override requests stay within the application-only reply.
Orientador is closed and silent by default; visible entry opens it, ambiguous messages remain choices, and user text is rendered without HTML execution.
Tutor tour highlights real search/results/agenda, handles empty results, supports manual voice, speed/pause/stop and opt-in narration; pause removes highlighting and narration.
Material tour reaches actual search, subject filter and empty library state; explicit focus control works with the keyboard.
Project orientation separates joining a team from creating an idea, highlights the real builder fields and never publishes or enters content.
Task and support tours reach existing forms and accessibility settings without creating tasks or changing preferences.
Module instructions live beside the actual highlighted input, with a transparent spotlight hole and no overlapping chat panel; input stays interactive.
Learning tour provides subject/topic scaffolding, waits for explicit Generate, and ends with understanding/reflection instead of marking learning as completed.
Adaptive pilot tour waits for a student to start practice and never answers or records a response on their behalf.
Orientation persists across routes; closing pauses it and restores launcher focus; unrelated navigation is respected until explicit return.
Nonmodal panel fits four viewports and dark/calm themes; assessment overlay suspends the guide and speech without automatic reopening.
Explicit deep-link opens once; chat stays out of storage and network, resets when account changes, and Escape closes the nonmodal assistant.
Missing targets remain an honest instruction instead of advancing automatically; unsupported voice leaves the full written guide usable.
scope: Real React pages/AppRouter and guide; synthetic account/services/speech API. No production writes or real audio output.
